principle: AI mastery, suggested TP evidence and teacher-confirmed TP remain separate. Tingkatan 2 diagnosis also checks Tingkatan 1 prerequisites before prescribing remediation.

confidence_rules.medium: repeated evidence within limited task types
confidence_rules.high: repeated cross-task/cross-date evidence with clear attribution

evidence_policy.written: usable for reading, writing, grammar and written literary response
evidence_policy.oral: audio/video/teacher observation required for pronunciation, intonation and interactive speaking
evidence_policy.ocr_uncertain: exclude from confirmed weakness until verified
evidence_policy.teacher_mark: takes priority for correctness when clearly visible

tp_policy: System may describe evidence consistent with TP characteristics but does not assign official PBD TP automatically.
